name: walkin
description: WalkIn booking platform — one Firebase backend, Next.js web/dashboard, Flutter mobile

scripts.build: npm run build -w @walkin/shared && npm run build -w @walkin/functions && npm run build -w @walkin/web
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @walkin/shared && npm run build -w @walkin/functions
scripts.test: npm run test -w @walkin/shared && npm run test -w @walkin/functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @walkin/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
